audit.why: The content layer's win[] rows — Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Master Yi, Skill, Master Yi — match the packet chart exactly and match every why beside them. There is no full layer on this matchup at all (currentText.full is null), so there is no second layer to disagree with; nothing to flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and late spikes talked about 'resets and ramping attack speed' and 'Highlander math' without ever stating what Highlander does or how long it lasts.
audit.why: Highlander is 85s, it makes him IMMUNE to slows — not merely fast — and 'passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist'. Slow immunity is the part that decides whether you can disengage from him at all, and it was never on the page.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text, whys[4], mid and late now name Highlander with its 85s cooldown and the slow immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions that decide this lane were absent. Meditate is described only as him 'stalling until his items arrive', with no mention that it is a channel. And nothing anywhere says his damage is partly true damage.
audit.why: Riot's text on W: Meditate restores health and reduces damage taken, on a flat 10s — and it is a channel, so any CC ends it. A knockup does not just chip through the heal, it deletes it, and it also stops him banking Double Strike stacks and pausing his Wuju Style and Highlander timers. That is the single highest-value thing a Wukong player can know here and it was missing. Separately, Wuju Style (14s) grants bonus TRUE damage on attacks, so armour stacking under-performs against him in exactly the phase the page tells you to stack it.
audit.corrected: Meditate's channel and the interrupt written into spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[2]; Wuju Style's true damage into whys[6], spikes[3].text and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. There were no numbers on the page.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 — a long cooldown for an untargetable dash — but 'basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown', so denying him autos is what keeps it down. Meditate is a flat 10s; Highlander 85s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early and mid, including the auto-attack reduction on Alpha Strike.
